description.en: A home for small scheduled jobs that have no app of their own: add, edit, pause, resume and run them by hand or by asking the AI assistant. The Space's scheduler runs them.
description.zh: 收纳没有自己界面的零散定时任务：新建、修改、暂停、恢复、立即运行，可以手动，也可以交给 AI 助手；运行由 Space 的调度器负责。

online.en: The AI assistant and AI jobs need a model
online.zh: AI 助手和 AI 任务需要模型

online.en: Jobs on other machines need their peers
online.zh: 其他机器上的任务需要 peer 在线
